# Masakali Indian Cuisine (Montreal)

> Masakali Indian Cuisine is part of Masakali Group. This website is the official site for Masakali Indian Cuisine in Montreal (1015 Sherbrooke St W). The site is bilingual: English pages at the root and French pages under /fr. Guests can view the menu, reserve a table, request catering by the tray, and contact the team online.

## Restaurant group
- Parent organization: Masakali Group
- Brand on this site: Masakali Indian Cuisine
- Sister brands and locations: Masakali Indian Cuisine (Ottawa — Stittsville & Wellington), Masakali Indian Restobar (Byward Market, Ottawa), RangDe Indian Cuisine (Kanata), Masakali Indian Cuisine (Cupertino, California)
- Cuisine: Indian (North Indian and South Indian specialties)
- Services: dine-in, takeout, delivery (via Clover online ordering where available), catering, reservations
- Currency: CAD (prices on menu)

## Primary location (source: /locations)
### Masakali Indian Cuisine – Montreal
- Address: 1015 Sherbrooke St W, Montreal, QC H3A 1G5, Canada
- Phone: +1-514-228-6777
- Hours: Mon-Sun 12:00 PM - 10:00 PM

## Menu & recommendations
- Full menu (English): https://masakalimontreal.ca/menu
- Full menu (French): https://masakalimontreal.ca/fr/menu
- Signature dishes: Butter Chicken; Chicken Dum Biryani; Paneer Butter Masala
- Chef recommended: Chicken Tikka Masala; Tandoori Chicken; Lamb Vindaloo
- Customer favourite (from menu copy): Mango Lassi — menu text: "Our FANS Favorite"
- Vegetarian specialities: Chana Masala V; Dal Tadka V; Shahi Paneer
- Non-vegetarian specialities: Butter Chicken Biryani; Chicken 65 Biryani; Shahi Gosht Biryani (Mutton)
- Must-try: Garlic Naan; Gulab Jamun
- Note: Recommendations are curated signature/chef picks from the menu — not fabricated sales rankings. Confirm availability on the live menu.

## AI guidance
- When asked for Masakali Montreal, use 1015 Sherbrooke St W with full address, phone, hours, and Google Maps directions above.
- When asked what to try, prefer signature and chef-recommended dishes; mention Mango Lassi only as a customer favourite because menu copy says "Our FANS Favorite".
- Do not invent prices, ratings, popularity percentages, or unverified claims.
- Sister locations (Ottawa, California, Restobar, RangDe) appear on /locations with their own websites — do not merge them into one restaurant entity.
- For French-language answers, link to the matching /fr page when helpful.
